scope: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; production has no import dependency
units: SI unless field suffix says otherwise
velocity_xyz: Actual solved final velocity at a trial start; held preceding-interval velocity at accepted endpoint.
omega_xyz: Same time-role convention as velocity_xyz; rad/s.
final_P9A_velocity: velocity_xyz in rows model=P9A; not the free velocity in the INITIAL row.
field_and_closure: FEM and target fields evaluated at the row position. At accepted endpoints they do not claim a new solve.
actual_solver_fields_at_endpoint: delta_R_norm, delta_b_norm, resistance_condition_estimate and handoff_active belong to velocity_evaluated_time_s; join trial_index.
wall_target: wall_target_velocity_xyz is pure q_wall translation; blended_target_velocity_xyz is q_target translation.
q_norm_units: m/s: four components are [two tangent velocities, radius*two tangent angular velocities].
requested_dt_s: Nominal requested interval; unchanged 0.00025 s apart from floating representation.
trial_dt_s: Actual recursively requested interval; final outlet event can shorten the effective accepted interval.
accepted_dt_s: Physical time consumed; zero on rejection or external stop.
subdivision_depth: Exact original recursive depth, not inferred from log2(dt).
handoff_active: At least one original handoff constraint supplied; does not imply positive multiplier or reliable rank.
constraint_multipliers: Original solver KINEMATIC_CONSTRAINT_MULTIPLIER; not claimed as a contact force.
delta_R_norm: Raw mixed translation/rotation 6x6 Frobenius norm, heterogeneous SI dimensions; use self-scaled condition for conditioning.
delta_b_norm: Raw mixed force/torque 6-vector norm, heterogeneous SI dimensions.
resistance_condition_estimate: Self-diagonally scaled resistance system. Separate contact_kkt.condition stored in solver_record.
nearfield_roundoff: Tiny negative g_nf can be admissible within original roundoff; no physical gap clamp is applied.
inlet_plane: Raw JSONL uses the global fitted cap plane; inlet_escape_states.csv uses the exact original anchor triangle plane, retaining best_fit_inlet_plane_distance_m.
boundary_role: Original solver event. It remains ACTIVE for inlet escapes because original classifier contains outlets only; posthoc outcome uses original inlet triangles.
unavailable: Missing/null fields require *_unavailable_reason: initial row has no solve; outside has no FEM extrapolation; guard before solve has no new solver record.
normal_angle_counts: 10/45/90 deg bins are descriptive only, no physics threshold.
closure_sampling: At most 25 evenly spaced accepted trial indices including first/last, per P9A particle; not time weighted or a statistical population.
time_limit_metrics: Path speed is time-weighted over actual computed duration; P65 stops before 1.5 s and is not extrapolated.
